messages:
Asha (partnerships): quick thread 94 we need a minimal joint-bench charter for new HW partners. focus: perf/W baseline, repeatability, signed artifacts, and marketplace pass criteria.

Diego (eng-runtime): agree. propose: 3 independent runs, 10m steady-state, report avg/95p/std, power sampled at 1s. lock kernel_hash+image.

Sana (eng-ml): add a micro-eval (500 prompts) to catch decode regressions. threshold: <2% delta on top-k accuracy or equivalent metric.

Omar (product): marketplace needs concrete buckets: pass (<=10% perf/W of reference), green SLA (<=5% latency regression), amber (10-25%), red (>25%). badge text will be "Redwood Verified: Performance". legal to review.

Nina (platform): bench-orchestrator config keys: hardware_id, kernel_hash, docker_image, model_ref, quant, run_seconds, repeats, power_sample_rate. artifacts: csv + json + sha256 + pdf summary.

bench-bot: scheduled NovusChip smoke at 07:00 PT tomorrow. will upload to s3://bench-results/novus/1745559999 and post results here.

Asha (partnerships): next steps: Diego drop run commands & measurement script, Sana prep eval bundle, Nina enable artifact signing, Omar coordinate badge wording with legal. I'll circulate checklist by EOD.

Diego (eng-runtime): on it. will include rollback signal: if 95p latency regresses >5% we mark build experimental and block listing.

Asha (partnerships): perfect 94 thanks all :white_check_mark:
